english.title: Fishing vessel owner, to which regulation 14 applies, fails in their duties to a fisherman who is pending repatriation
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a fishing vessel owner on which the duty to repatriate a fisherman in regulation 14 of the Merchant Shipping (Work in Fishing Convention) Regulations 2018 applied, failed to make such provision as was necessary for the relief and maintenance of such a fisherman, namely **(..SPECIFY FISHERMAN..), pending repatriation
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 17(6) and 29(1) of the Merchant Shipping (Work in Fishing Convention) Regulations 2018
